verdicts.verify_by: apply the rewrite's shotEnv helper and run gofmt -l . ; go vet ./... ; go test ./... in misc/gnopreview, then count non-comment lines before and after with grep -v '^[[:space:]]*//' shots.go | grep -c '[^[:space:]]'
verdicts.tldr: the two screenshot passes carry the same 15-line browser-and-server prologue, so a step added to one silently skips the other
verdicts.details: diff of shots.go:51-65 against shots.go:117-131 at head returns two hunks only: the message word ("before/after" vs "screenshots") and the serve() result name (origin vs base). Everything else — findChrome, the empty-bin bail, serve, defer Close, MkdirAll(outDir/_shots, 0o755) — is byte-identical. A Chrome flag or a temp-profile dir added for one pass therefore lands in one function and not the other, and the before/after pair and the gnoweb sample then disagree on the same runner. Fix: hoist the prologue into one shotEnv(outDir, chrome, lost) helper returning (bin, origin, io.Closer), as the finder's diff does.

verdicts.verify_by: git apply the rewrite and run, from misc/gnopreview: gofmt -l . && go vet ./... && go test ./... ; the shotFile helper returns the single relative path and hands filepath.Join(outDir, rel) to chromeShot
verdicts.tldr: each screenshot's path is spelled twice, so a naming change touching one spelling publishes a comment whose image link points at a file Chrome never wrote
verdicts.details: Three sites spell one path twice: 79/83 (name+"-after.png"), 91/92 (name+"-before.png") and 138/143 (s.name+".png"), the first spelling filepath.Join(outDir, shotsDir, ...) for Chrome and the second path.Join(shotsDir, ...) for the comment. Nothing reconciles them: chromeShot's only check is os.Stat on the path it was handed (shots.go:187), so a comment path that drifted from the written path is never noticed and the PR comment renders a broken image. Fix: build the relative path once and pass filepath.Join(outDir, rel) to chromeShot, as the finder's shotFile helper does.
verdicts.evidence: Read of shots.go at head: 79 filepath.Join(outDir, shotsDir, name+"-after.png") vs 83 path.Join(shotsDir, name+"-after.png"); 91 vs 92 for -before.png; 138 vs 143 for s.name+".png". shots.go:187 'if fi, err := os.Stat(out); err != nil || fi.Size() == 0' is the only post-write check and reads chromeShot's own argument. Rewrite applied at ecf7af0: gofmt -l . no output, go vet clean, 'ok  github.com/gnolang/gno/misc/gnopreview  0.005s'; non-comment lines 169 -> 170, file lines 213 -> 223. Merge base bbd9b2f has no misc/gnopreview at all.

verdicts.verify_by: sed -n '337,345p' crawl.go shows FileOf is exactly that lookup; swap the three lines for src, ok := c.FileOf(s.url) and run go test ./... in misc/gnopreview | grep -n 'c.pages\[' misc/gnopreview/*.go | grep -n 'c.pages\[' misc/gnopreview/*.go
verdicts.tldr: Screenshot hand-inlines FileOf's body instead of calling it, so a later change to how a URL maps to a file reaches the pair pass and silently not the gnoweb sample
verdicts.details: shots.go:134-137 is 'p, ok := c.pages[canonicalURL(s.url)]' then p.File, which is FileOf's body verbatim (crawl.go:338-344), and grep shows shots.go:134 is the only read of c.pages outside crawl.go that spells the canonicalURL lookup rather than calling the accessor — the sibling ScreenshotPairs already calls FileOf at line 72. The finder's second half, that Screenshot's keying disagrees with Crawler.Run's raw insert at crawl.go:143, does not hold as a defect of this line: FileOf carries the identical canonicalURL(), so the swap changes nothing, and canonicalURL is the identity on all four shotPlan URLs today. Fix: replace the three lines with src, ok := c.FileOf(s.url).
